ontology.name: FIBO Industry Classification
ontology.description: Economic sectors, subsectors, and NAICS industry groups with climate and cyclicality attributes. Adapted from EDM Council FIBO. Source: https://github.com/edmcouncil/fibo — MIT License.

entityTypes.name: Sector
entityTypes.description: Top-level economic sector grouping industries by broad function.

entityTypes.name: Subsector
entityTypes.description: Subdivision of an economic sector for finer-grained classification.

entityTypes.name: IndustryGroup
entityTypes.description: NAICS-coded industry group with climate sensitivity and cyclicality attributes for risk analysis.

relationships.name: partOfSector
relationships.description: Links a subsector to its parent economic sector.

relationships.name: belongsToSubsector
relationships.description: Links an industry group to its parent subsector.
